Ratio

Nursery practitioner

Education and childcare

\(\displaystyle 1 : 5\)

How many staff does this room legally need?

By law there must be at least 1 adult for every 5 two-year-olds in a nursery in England. The two-year-olds' room has 13 children.

  1. \(13 \div 5 = 2.6\), and you can't have 0.6 of an adult, so round up: 3 staff.

The answer: \(13 \div 5 = 2.6\), so 3 adults
